# Best Philosophy Quotes | Philosophy Defined

> Editor-selected best philosophy quotes in English—passages on wisdom, freedom, virtue, knowledge, and how to live.

Editorial selection

## Best philosophy quotes

Not a ranking by popularity alone. These passages were chosen for clarity, argumentative bite, and lasting use in teaching and reflection.

This is the archive's editorial judgement, exercised out in the open. The neighbouring collections answer different questions: [famous](https://www.philosophydef.com/quotes/famous) is about historical recognition, [short](https://www.philosophydef.com/quotes/short) is about length. This page is about which passages are worth a reader's first hour.

### How these passages were chosen

Three tests, applied in order. **Argument:** the passage carries a claim a reader could accept, reject, or refine — not a mood looking for a caption. **Clarity:** the English renders the thought without hiding it, and where a translation choice does interpretive work, the archive entry says so. **Use:** the passage repays rereading — it is the kind of sentence a seminar, an essay, or a careful person can build on.

Selection is from the sourced corpus, never beside it: every passage below keeps its work, locator, and edition on its own page, and the popular forms that differ from the text are recorded there too.
